headline: AI/ML and Backend Engineer
summary: Computer Engineering student at the University of Dubai on a full scholarship. Builds applied AI and computer vision tools, backend systems and full-stack web apps, with shipped work in health, education and hospitality.

projectHighlights.clixa-tools: The model never does the arithmetic: it can only call the 63 real calculators as tools.
projectHighlights.avatar-kit: MediaPipe face tracking drives head pose, blinks, gaze and mouth through a Verlet physics rig, smoothed with One Euro filters.
projectHighlights.visionaid: Reads text, finds objects and warns about traffic on-device. Built for the 19th IEEE Student Day competition.
